verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some built-in AI help. The homepage says users can 'Prompt, run, edit, and deploy AI agents in seconds', and the error docs say you can 'debug these errors with AI' from within the product. Both are brief marketing or doc mentions with no detail on what a user can actually hand off to an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of a general-purpose in-product AI assistant (e.g., building or editing workflows from natural language), a description of its scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
